name: NeoSoul
steps: Open airdrop.neosoul.ai from NeoSoul's own X post or site, and check the address.
If an amount shows, press Confirm before 22 October, 16:00 UTC. After the deadline the page shows: "The confirmation window has closed."

Wait for delivery. The page says tokens are sent within a set number of days of your first check, "and no later than Oct 23, 2026, 00:00 (UTC+8)". It also says: "Airdrops are sent in order of first airdrop queries."

Before you add DNA to a wallet or trade it, compare the contract with the one in NeoSoul's paper. Many look-alike tokens appear after a launch. Warning NeoSoul says: "NeoSoul will never DM you to ask for funds, seed phrases or private keys." Anyone who messages you about your DNA allocation isn't NeoSoul.

For future rewards, which nobody has promised, do the Questboard tasks at event.neosoul.ai . evoevo's own terms say: "New users should consider using a dedicated test wallet or a low-value wallet before connecting a wallet that holds significant assets."
what: NeoSoul's DNA token launched on 16 Oct 2026 and its airdrop checker closes on 22 Oct. How to check and confirm, what PTS points do, and the risks.
behind: Odaily reported on 20 August 2026 that "NeoSoul has announced the completion of an $11 million Pre-A funding round, with participation from MH Ventures, Amber Group, ArkStream Capital, 0G Foundation, Kirin Capital, CatcherVC, and New Oak International." NeoSoul's own blog gives the same round. Crypto Briefing adds an earlier $4 million seed and says NeoSoul spun off from TechFlow; NeoSoul's tokeno
costs: The airdrop check costs nothing beyond a signature, as far as the page's code shows. The PTS tasks for X, Telegram and Discord are free. The daily task needs an on-chain action in evoevo, and voting there costs gas: "Click [Agree] and pay gas to bet on the truth before the outcome!" No gas amounts are published. NeoTrade is free to try in Paper mode. It sells credit in fixed top-ups of $5, $20 and
risks: No list of excluded countries is published for the airdrop or the Questboard. evoevo's terms leave it to you: you "must make sure that your access to evoevo.ai is permitted in your location". For NeoTrade the docs say: "Polymarket restricts access from the United States and over 35 other jurisdictions. NeoTrade does not perform any location check." evoevo's terms say its points have no cash value
